rationale: Both source operands have been read for control case-002: us-gaap NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities in USD, covering January through September of 2018 and 2017 respectively.
The matching nine-month periods support a historical year-over-year operating cash flow difference, with latest then prior operands; fiscal_period Q3 does not make these standalone quarterly flows.
